st: OpenAI's new o1 model: a new era for humanity?

sec.p: I know, we're tired of pairing “intelligence” with “artificial”. But OpenAI's new model, o1 (aka Project Strawberry), opens up a futuro fortissimo. I couldn't let it pass.
The new model's abilities are astonishing, especially in fields with a single right answer (science, maths, coding).

sec.t: ff.103.3 The new Era of Intelligence
sec.p: OpenAI applied deep learning (the same as AlphaGo, ♟️ ff.18.4 Artistic chess: the king of chess) to text generation. A new paradigm, so much so that OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman talks of an Age of Intelligence.
